channel.title: Social Media Today - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Social Media Today (socialmediatoday.com)

item.title: WhatsApp adds catch-up function to group chats
item.description: The platform’s Group Message History will give admins the option of forwarding up to 100 previously submitted messages to new members.

item.title: Brands see biggest growth on TikTok but organic reach is slowing on Instagram
item.description: The 2026 Social Media Benchmarks report from Emplifi also showed flat to negative follower growth on X, as well as the latest metrics for LinkedIn and Facebook.

item.title: Threads now offers simplified sharing to Instagram
item.description: A new share button allows users to add public content automatically to Instagram Stories, potentially increasing views per post.

item.title: X appeals $140M penalty from the EU Commission
item.description: In a post from the platform’s Global Government Affairs team, X questioned the original investigation and called the challenge a “landmark case.”

item.title: X nears completion of search code rewrite
item.description: The platform’s head of product, Nikita Bier, also said X was improving bot detection in order to mitigate the effect of artificial intelligence bots.

item.title: X plans to combat AI-generated content while promoting Grok
item.description: The platform’s head of product announced anti-bot detection measures, while its chatbot is being widely offered to assist with post creation.

item.title: Film studio association issues new censure against ByteDance’s AI tool
item.description: The Motion Picture Association sent a strongly worded letter to the Seedance owner demanding that it stop training on copyrighted material, per Variety.

item.title: Instagram emphasizes Reels in new design update
item.description: Customizable feed options and a new Your Feeds center give users another way to access Reels content, according to an app researcher.

item.title: X tests AI labeling to combat the rise of generated content
item.description: The app is working on a process that would require users to label posts created using artificial intelligence tools, according to an app researcher.

item.title: Professional AI adoption could unlock up to $4.1 trillion capacity for US
item.description: A new report from LinkedIn found that more needs to be done in order to maximize the benefit of artificial intelligence in the workforce.
